scope: Source-certified Jedi Academy Training Manual talents compared against current repository talent-record mirror. No production records changed.
hierarchyFindings: Sith Alchemy is one talent. Create Sith Amulet, Create Sith Armor, Create Sith Talisman, and Create Sith Weapon are procedures inside that talent.
Table 1-1 (Sith Alchemy) is supporting rules for Sith Alchemy Specialist; its trait rows are not talent identities.
The Optional Rule: Daily Force Points sidebar interrupting Guardian Spirit is not part of that talent.
The New Species: Shards sidebar interrupting the Iron Knight layout is not a talent-tree boundary.
No Phase 1D talent-membership correction was required.
